note: Transportstyrelsen's pages (read 2026-10-30): the B page lists, among the conditions, that the holder has turned 18 (practice driving from 16); the fees page gives issuing or renewing a licence at 375 kr (the tests and the photograph are Trafikverket's, not held); the renewal page says a licence with the lower classes is valid for ten years from issue. Sweden's identity card is the Police's and isn't held here; no exchange list was read.
